description: Small layout pieces of the item screens (inventory, results). rule_*: the flat rectangle along the top edge of every item screen (corners in screen units from the centre, colour [r, g, b]). notice_*: the message the inventory's MAP entry shows when the map cannot be looked at (too dark, no map); the strings are in the game font's form ('_' = space, '\t' = indent) and are translated by their English text. notice_color is a menu font colour name (gold, dark_grey, green, red, light_grey, white). A mod patches it with its own menu/item_screens.json.
